band_slug_announcements_subtitle_body: Posts to everyone on the roster.
band_slug_edit_band_profile_form_never_s: Never shown publicly. Your page offers a contact form instead, and a message sent through it lands here — or at your press kit's booking contact, if you have set one.
band_slug_edit_band_profile_form_public_: Anyone can see this band's profile, no login required
band_slug_edit_band_profile_form_renamin: Renaming the band doesn't move its address.
band_slug_edit_band_profile_form_short_o: A short one-liner shown on your directory card
band_slug_edit_band_profile_form_shown_a: Shown as “Based in” on your profile
band_slug_edit_band_profile_form_soundcl: SoundCloud, YouTube, and Spotify links show as embedded players on your profile.
band_slug_events_create_event_modal_save: Saved as a draft. The end time, venue, bill, poster and tickets are filled in on the event's page next.
band_slug_events_event_fields_optional_c: Optional — clear it if you don't know.
band_slug_events_event_fields_shown_even: Shown on your events list, your band's page, and the community calendar.
band_slug_events_event_fields_what_peopl: What people pay, at the door or through the link. Leave blank if it's free.
band_slug_events_event_id_band_admins_ca: Band admins can edit this event.
band_slug_events_event_id_credited_text: Your band is credited on this bill. Only the band that created the listing can change it.
band_slug_events_event_id_credited_added: Your band is credited on this bill, added by {name}. Only the band that created the listing can change it.
band_slug_events_event_id_event_cancelle: This event is cancelled, so it can no longer be edited.
band_slug_events_event_id_ticket_sale_ca: 0 lets people pay what they can.
Buyers pay on the collective's site and the money lands in your own Stripe account. The collective suggests {suggested}% for itself; buyers see the split and can move it, down to nothing.
Finish setting up payouts first. Ticket money goes straight to your own Stripe account.
Selling tickets through the collective is part of the premium plan.
{sold} sold, suggested {price}. Cancelling the gig refunds every buyer.
{sold} sold of {quantity}, suggested {price}. Cancelling the gig refunds every buyer.
band_slug_events_import_gigs_modal_date_: {#code}date | venue | title | ticket link{/code} — only the date is required. Start a title with {#code}w/{/code} to list the other bands. Gigs must be in the past, {GIG_IMPORT_MAX_LINES} at a time. Imported gigs are published with no end time.
band_slug_events_import_gigs_modal_place: 2024-03-14 | Bombs Away Cafe | w/ Paper Wolves 2023-11-02 | The Majestic Theatre
band_slug_events_request_correction_desc: The date, the spelling of your name, the set times — whatever is wrong.
band_slug_events_request_correction_goes: This goes to CorvMC staff, who can edit any listing. They'll reply in your Messages.
band_slug_events_request_correction_succ: Sent — staff will pick it up
band_slug_members_about_transfer_ownersh: You are about to transfer ownership of {#strong}{name}{/strong} to {#strong}{name2}{/strong}. You will be demoted to admin. This cannot be undone without the new owner's consent.
band_slug_members_description_body: Invite anyone else in this band so they can book sessions and manage events.
band_slug_members_edit_member_descriptio: Admins can edit the band profile, its events, and its members.
band_slug_members_invite_someone_who_doe: Invite someone who doesn't have a CorvMC account yet. They'll receive an email with a signup link and be automatically added to your band.
band_slug_members_re_viewing_band_as_sta: You're viewing this band as staff. Roster changes go through staff tools.
band_slug_members_start_typing_name_emai: Start typing a name or email...
band_slug_members_there_nobody_else_band: There is nobody else in the band to transfer ownership to.
band_slug_members_your_membership_as_own: As the owner you can't leave {#strong}{bandName}{/strong} until you transfer ownership to another active member.
band_slug_members_your_membership_confir: Leave {bandName}? You'll need to be re-invited to rejoin.
band_slug_members_your_membership_how_re: How you're credited on this band's roster and site. Leave blank to use your account name.
band_slug_members_your_membership_what_p: What you play in this band. Admins can change this too.
band_slug_messages_enquiry_list_empty_bo: When someone uses the booking form on your profile, it lands here.
band_slug_messages_enquiry_list_enquirie: Enquiries from your public booking form. Replies go back by email; nobody sees your address.
band_slug_messages_open_band_s_chat_from: Open the band’s chat from the list on the left.
band_slug_messages_open_band_s_chat_pick: Open the band’s chat, or pick an enquiry, from the list on the left.
band_slug_music_create_release_modal_des: When it came out — leave blank if you'd rather not say. This is what orders your discography, so an old record can keep its real date.
band_slug_music_description_body: Upload a record and it gets a page on the site, a spot in your profile, and — if you want it — a place in the CMC Radio rotation.
band_slug_music_payouts_free_releases_sk: Free releases skip all of this. A record priced at nothing needs no Stripe account and can still go out on CMC Radio.
band_slug_music_payouts_not_fixed_buyers: {suggested}% is {#em}suggested{/em}, not fixed. Buyers see the split before they pay and can move it — down to nothing, or up. Card processing comes off the top before either of you is paid, so you and the collective fund it in proportion to what you take — unless the buyer chooses to cover it, in which case you both keep the full amount.
band_slug_music_payouts_sales_go_straigh: Sales go straight to your own Stripe account on its own payout schedule — the collective never holds your money. Bank details and payout history live in Stripe.
band_slug_music_payouts_sell_release_nee: To sell a release you need a Stripe account of your own. Stripe collects the details it needs to pay you and to handle your tax forms; the collective never sees your bank information.
band_slug_music_release_id_add_at_least_: Add at least one track before publishing.
band_slug_music_release_id_attestation_r: The attestation for this release has run out or its wording has changed, so it is off the air until someone confirms the statement below.
band_slug_music_release_id_cmc_staff_wit: CMC staff withheld this release{value}. It is not public and cannot be republished from here. Reply to the message staff sent you to sort it out.
band_slug_music_release_id_delete_audio_: Delete {#strong}{title}{/strong}? The audio file is removed for good. Anyone who already bought this release keeps their download.
band_slug_music_release_id_empty_body: No tracks yet. Add some audio and this is where it plays.
band_slug_music_release_id_if_anyone_has: If anyone has bought this release it is archived instead of deleted, so their download keeps working.
band_slug_music_release_id_name_minimum_: Name a minimum. Free is a real answer — it needs no Stripe account, and the record can still go out on CMC Radio.
band_slug_music_release_id_placeholder: Who played on it, where it was recorded, anything you'd want a listener to know.
band_slug_music_release_id_publish_becom: Publish {#strong}{title}{/strong}? It becomes visible on your band's profile and at its own address.
band_slug_music_release_id_publishing_pu: Publishing puts this record on your profile and gives it a page anyone can link to.
band_slug_music_release_id_put_record_ro: Put this record in the rotation of the station that plays across the site. Independent of selling — a free release can be on the air, and no Stripe account is needed.
band_slug_music_release_id_release_has_p: This release has a price, but payouts are not set up yet, so nobody can buy it. {#a}Set up payouts{/a} — or set the price to zero to give it away.
band_slug_music_release_id_release_off_a: This release is off the air until someone confirms the statement below.
band_slug_music_release_id_release_publi: This release is public. Unpublishing hides it from the site and takes it off the radio; anyone who bought it keeps their download.
band_slug_music_release_id_required_go_a: Required to go on the air, and again every year. CMC Radio holds no performing-rights licence, so it plays only original songs by writers who are not members of a performing-rights organisation.
band_slug_music_release_id_square_art_sh: Square art, shown wherever the record appears.
band_slug_music_release_id_staff_pulled_: Staff pulled this release from the rotation{value}.
band_slug_music_release_id_station_pays_: The station pays no licence fees, so it can only play original songs written entirely by band members who don’t belong to a performing-rights organisation. Covers, and songs with anyone else’s material in them, would need licences from the PROs and SoundExchange, so they can’t go on the air.
band_slug_music_release_id_station_plays: The station plays tracks between {formatRuntime} and {formatRuntime2} long, so it will skip {join}. The rest of the record still plays.
band_slug_music_release_id_track_uploade: MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, OGG or Opus, up to {maxLabel} each.
band_slug_packing_anything_band_needs_re: Anything the band needs reminding of
band_slug_packing_can_edit_as_admin_but_: You can edit this as an admin — but they know their own gear.
band_slug_packing_description_body: Where the trailer key lives, which door to load through. Nobody outside the band reads this.
band_slug_packing_editing_here_changes_w: Editing here changes what the band brings. It never unpacks a box or drops whoever agreed to carry one.
band_slug_packing_load_in_list_nothing_l: Nothing on the list yet. Add what you bring below and it shows up here.
band_slug_packing_merch_tub_spare_stands: The merch tub, the spare stands — things nobody owns but somebody still has to carry. Admins only, because there is no member whose crate it is.
band_slug_packing_never_cleared_ticks_st: Never cleared. Ticks stay until somebody resets them.
band_slug_packing_packing_items_editor_d: Only for things that stand on a stage. A first-aid kit is not one.
band_slug_packing_packing_items_editor_l: {PACKING_MAX_ITEMS} is the limit for one crate.
band_slug_packing_promote_to_rider_bring: You bring these and they stand on a stage, but the desk has not been told. Adding one leaves the rest of your rider exactly as it is.
band_slug_packing_promote_to_rider_some_: Some of this belongs on your rider
band_slug_packing_re_reading_as_staff_on: You're reading this as staff. Only the band's own members can change it, or tick anything off.

match.unassignedCountPlural=one: {#strong}{unassignedCount}{/strong} thing has nobody bringing them. That is how gear gets left behind — not because nobody knew it existed.
match.unassignedCountPlural=*: {#strong}{unassignedCount}{/strong} things have nobody bringing them. That is how gear gets left behind — not because nobody knew it existed.

band_slug_packing_what_bring_only_band_s: What you bring. Only you and the band's admins can change this.
band_slug_page_editor_page_editor_availa: The page editor is available with a premium subscription. Your band's page arrives already built — reorder its blocks, hide the ones you don't want, and make it yours with genre themes and custom CSS.
band_slug_page_editor_show_contact_form_: Show contact form (messages are emailed to your booking contact)
band_slug_page_editor_style_panel_page_s: This page's theme rules have been folded into your CSS, so you can see all of them. Nothing has changed about how it looks.
band_slug_page_editor_style_panel_read_o: Read-only. Customize to take these rules over — the theme stops applying and this becomes your whole page.
band_slug_page_editor_style_panel_wrappe: Wrapped in {#code}.band-site-container{/code}, so a bare selector like {#code}h1{/code} only ever affects your page. Max 50KB; external stylesheets and scripts are stripped.
band_slug_press_kit_contact_role_fields_: Package only — never shown on your public page.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_award: Awards, notable supports, festivals, milestones. Shown on your public page.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_every: Everything on this page is free for every act. Contacts and phone numbers go only in the press kit you download and send — they are never published on your public page, where a booker reaches you through a contact form instead. What you need on stage is a separate document: your {#a}tech rider{/a}.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_if_so: If someone else handles the business.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_live_: Live clips, on your page and in your press kit. Paste a YouTube link.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_packa: Package only. Your public page offers a contact form instead, so none of this is published.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_where: Where a booking enquiry from your public page is delivered.
band_slug_press_kit_press_kit_form_who_j: Who a journalist should ask for.
band_slug_press_kit_press_photos_band_si: · a band site lifts the limit
band_slug_press_kit_press_photos_descrip: What the photo shows, for someone who cannot see it.
band_slug_press_kit_press_photos_high_re: A high-resolution shot a venue or a listings editor can print. Shown on your public page and included full-size in your downloadable kit.
band_slug_press_kit_press_photos_no_pres: No press photo yet. Your band's logo is set on the profile page.
band_slug_press_kit_press_photos_zip_hol: A zip holding a one-page press kit, a plain-text version to paste into an email, your photos at full resolution, and your stage plot and rider. It carries a QR code back to your public page, so the shows list a venue sees stays current after you send it.
band_slug_press_kit_progress_didn_t_body: Your press kit progress didn't load. The rest of the dashboard is up to date.
band_slug_put_flyer_bio_goes_s_text: Put this on a flyer or in a bio — it goes to {name}'s page.
band_slug_reservations_create_modal_firs: The first instance is waitlisted because the slot is currently booked.
band_slug_reservations_description_body: Book the practice space and it'll show up here for the whole band.
band_slug_reservations_id_booked_session: {title} booked this session and can settle it.
band_slug_reservations_id_code_issued_bu: The code is issued but the door hasn't confirmed it yet. It should be ready before the session — check back here, and get in touch if it still isn't showing.
band_slug_reservations_id_door_code_appe: The door code appears here on the day of the session.
band_slug_reservations_id_enter_code_doo: Enter this code on the door keypad. It works for the length of the session, for whoever on the band gets there first.
band_slug_reservations_id_session_s_code: This session's code hasn't reached the door and we don't have a backup to give you right now. Don't wait outside — {#a}get in touch{/a} and someone will let the band in.
band_slug_reservations_id_settled_nothin: Settled — nothing owed at the door.
band_slug_reservations_id_we_couldn_t_co: We couldn't confirm this session's usual code reached the door, so this one will get the band in for now. Staff know about it. If it doesn't work, call us rather than waiting outside.
band_slug_rider_can_edit_as_admin_but_bo: You can edit this as an admin — but they can too, and they know their own rig.
band_slug_rider_every_rider_guide_asks_o: Every rider guide asks for one name. It is the field most often missing.
band_slug_rider_filling_list_above_not_c: Filling in the list above is not compulsory. If you already send venues a rider PDF, upload it here and CMC will read that instead — and you can do both, which is what a typed input list beside a hand-drawn stage plot looks like.
band_slug_rider_hand_over_one_already_ha: Or hand over the one you already have
band_slug_rider_list_asks_channels_room_: This asks for {#strong}{channelCount}{/strong} channels and the room's desk takes {#strong}{consoleChannels}{/strong}. Nothing is wrong with the rider — but the house engineer will be combining or dropping inputs, and it is worth agreeing which ones before load-in rather than at it.
band_slug_rider_list_no_channels_listed_: No channels listed yet. Anyone in the band can add theirs from the rider page.
band_slug_rider_power_load_anything_not_: Power, load-in, anything that is not a piece of gear.
band_slug_rider_re_reading_as_staff_only: You're reading this as staff. Only the band's own members can change it.
band_slug_rider_rider_asks_channels_room: This rider asks for {#strong}{channelCount}{/strong} channels and the room's desk takes {#strong}{consoleChannels}{/strong}. That is not a problem to solve here — the house engineer will combine or drop inputs — but it is worth agreeing which ones before load-in.
band_slug_rider_shared_kit_belongs_nobod: Shared kit that belongs to nobody in particular — playback rigs, spare stands. Admins only, because there is no member whose corner it is.
band_slug_rider_what_bring_what_needs_pl: What you bring and what it needs plugged in. Only you and the band's admins can change this.
band_slug_rider_where_everything_stands_: Where everything stands. Drag it, or use the arrow keys once something is focused — "Place exactly" below types the same numbers. Channel order on the input list is a separate thing and this does not touch it.
band_slug_settings_band_address_section_: That address is reserved — pick another.
This is your band's address. It's also your profile at {#code}/directory/bands/{slug}{/code} and your dashboard at {#code}/band/{slug}{/code}.
Letters, numbers and hyphens. Spaces and punctuation are dropped.

Links to {#strong}{slug}.{baseDomain}{/strong} will forward to the new address — but only until another band claims it, and then they stop. Update anywhere you've printed or posted the old one. You can only change this a few times a year.
Only the band's owner can change this address.
band_slug_settings_custom_domain_section: Add these records at your domain registrar, then check the status. Verification usually takes a few minutes once the records are live.
Custom domains aren't set up on this site yet. Your band's site is always available at {#strong}{freeAddress}{/strong}.
Enter it without http:// — we'll give you the DNS records to add.
Domain added — add the DNS records to finish
Serve your band's site from a domain you own. Your free address, {#strong}{freeAddress}{/strong}, keeps working either way.
Your site is live at {#strong}{domain}{/strong}. Point the domain at {#code}{cnameTarget}{/code} with a CNAME record if you haven't already.
We couldn't verify this domain. Check the records below, or remove it and try again.
band_slug_settings_deleting_band_will_ca: Deleting this band will cancel all future reservations and remove all members. This action cannot be undone.
band_slug_settings_re_viewing_band_as_st: You're viewing this band as staff. The band's address and deletion are owner-only — staff tools for this band are on the staff band page.
band_slug_settings_sure_want_permanently: Are you sure you want to permanently delete {#strong}{name}{/strong}? All future reservations will be cancelled and all members will be removed.
band_slug_subscription_band_already_has_: Your band already has {#strong}{slug}.{baseDomain}{/strong}, pointing at your directory profile. Premium turns it into a real website — a block editor, custom CSS, genre themes, a full EPK — and lets you serve it from your own domain.
band_slug_subscription_band_s_card_not_m: This is the band's card, not a member's. Replacing it here does not touch anyone's own membership.
band_slug_subscription_genre_themed_temp: {#span}✓{/span} Genre-themed templates (Punk, Jazz, Metal, Indie, Electronic, Folk)
band_slug_subscription_no_card_saved_act: No card is saved for this act. Renewals will fail until one is.
band_slug_subscription_own_domain_keep_u: {#span}✓{/span} Your own domain — or keep using {slug}.{baseDomain}
band_slug_subscription_page_arrives_alre: {#span}✓{/span} A page that arrives already built — reorder its blocks and hide what you don't need
band_slug_subscription_subscription_will: Subscription will cancel at end of billing period
band_slug_subscription_unlimited_press_p: {#span}✓{/span} Unlimited press photos, instead of one
band_slug_subscription_video_section_liv: {#span}✓{/span} A video section — live clips on your page and in your press kit
band_slug_subscription_we_could_not_reac: We could not reach our payment processor just now, so the card on file is unknown.
band_slug_subscription_we_haven_t_had_co: We haven't had confirmation from our payment processor yet. Your card has been charged and premium switches on as soon as it lands — if this page still says otherwise in a few minutes, get in touch.
